_readme: Public catalogue categories (owner ruling 2026-10-21): exactly Preparation, Washing, Cooking, Storage and Refrigeration. "products" maps every published product id to one of them; "excludedProducts" lists the other non-equipment items of the master (id -> reason) that are NOT published. Products in the master categories exhaust_system, fresh_air_system, gas_line and fire_suppression are excluded in scripts/build-catalogue.js (EXCLUDED_CATEGORIES) and need no entry here. scripts/build-catalogue.js refuses a master product that is in none of these places, so a new product forces an explicit decision. The private master is never edited.
